mods.name: Blessing of Pandora
mods.description:
Blessing of Pandora is a Forge 1.20.1 addon for Curse of Pandora that reverses the seven reality curses into seven ideal blessings.
It adds in-place curse-to-blessing conversion, Soul Sculpting, Pandora bracelet chapters, JEI reversal guides, and Touhou Little Maid support.

releases.notes:
# 1.7.3fix

## 中文

- 修复安装车万女仆时，部分方法注入失败导致游戏无法启动的问题。
- 首次自然驯服女仆时自动记录契约，即使当时未戴潘多拉项链，之后戴上也能获得爱恋，仍永久绑定第一位女仆，每人一次。待领记录在死亡、重登后保留，获取说明同步更新。
- 为错过奖励且无绑定记录的旧存档玩家增加一次补领：佩戴潘多拉项链，潜行右键自己的女仆，领取爱恋并永久绑定她。已领取、已有绑定或违誓永久损毁后不可补领。
- 修复先接收转让女仆，再首次自然驯服时无法获得爱恋的问题。
- 修复进化宝珠与其他飞行来源交替时，飞行权限错误残留或被收回的问题。
- 修复塑魂、强壮属性的生命加成在读档时丢血，以及加成降低或消失后生命超过上限的问题。
- 修复反转 HUD 在小窗口下，过长条目无法完整显示、滚动查看或点击的问题。
- 优化塑魂续期、反转界面请求同步和潘多拉诅咒附魔查询，减少重复处理；效果条件与动态附魔仍即时检测。

适用 Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge 47.4.10+。建议客户端和服务端同时更新至 1.7.3fix。必装潘多拉之咒 2.4.26+、Curios 5.4.5+；若安装 JEI，需 15.20.0.106 或更新版本；车万女仆为可选联动，需 1.5.3 或更新版本。

## English

- Fixed method injection failures that prevented the game from starting with Touhou Little Maid installed.
- Your first naturally tamed maid is now recorded even without a Pandora Necklace. Wear one later to receive Love once per player, permanently bound to that same maid. Pending rewards survive death and relogging, and acquisition descriptions have been updated.
- Added a one-time recovery for older saves that missed the reward and have no recorded binding: wear a Pandora Necklace and sneak-right-click your own maid to receive Love and bind her permanently. Previous claims, existing bindings and permanent vow bans cannot be bypassed.
- Fixed receiving a transferred maid preventing Love from being awarded on the first natural tame.
- Fixed the evolved orb incorrectly retaining or revoking flight when other flight sources changed.
- Fixed health bonuses from Soul Sculpting and the Strong attribute losing current health on load, or leaving health above its maximum when reduced or removed.
- Fixed long reversal HUD entries becoming unreadable, impossible to scroll through or unclickable in small windows.
- Optimized Soul Sculpting renewal, reversal HUD request synchronization and Pandora Curse enchantment lookups to reduce repeated work. Effect conditions and dynamic enchantments are still checked immediately.

For Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge 47.4.10+. Update both client and server to 1.7.3fix. Requires Curse of Pandora 2.4.26+ and Curios 5.4.5+. JEI is optional; if installed, use 15.20.0.106 or newer. Touhou Little Maid is optional; if installed, use 1.5.3 or newer.

releases.notes:
# 1.7.3

## 中文

- 修复第七诅咒反转后仍显示诅咒名称的问题，并为七个祝福补齐名称兜底；已有祝福自动显示正确名称，保留其它自定义改名。
- 优化七个诅咒的 JEI 反转页面，适配原生信息页宽度，统一编号、换行和缩进；长内容可滚动查看，概率与进度仍实时更新。
- 新增车万女仆联动宝珠「爱恋」及其进化形态「永生不悔·此生难忘」，仅在安装车万女仆时出现。佩戴潘多拉项链驯服第一位女仆时获得爱恋，每人一次，并永久绑定该女仆。
- 爱恋在潘多拉串饰栏位佩戴时，向自己的女仆共享已适配的宝珠、诅咒、祝福和套装串饰效果；玩家专属机制及未适配的第三方效果列入黑名单。
- 进化需佩戴累计 24 小时、绑定女仆从未死亡；佩戴期间由她累计造成 1,314,520 点实际生命伤害、玩家与她对战五子棋、中国象棋、国际象棋各胜一次、双方在同一维度的繁花森林累计超过 30 分钟，并发送同时含「女仆」「我爱你」且不含禁用词的聊天誓言。
- 首次佩戴后，另驯女仆会清零累计进度并使进化宝珠退回爱恋，绑定与死亡记录保留。聊天同时含「女仆」及禁用词会永久损毁两种宝珠，创造副本和掉落物也会销毁；卸下、重登或进化不豁免惩罚。禁用词按字面匹配，正面句中含「不」也会触发。
- 进化后保留共享能力，并让玩家与绑定女仆获得致命伤回满（各自独立 3 秒冷却）、飞行、伤害 +1314%（×14.14）和 520 有效护甲；玩家攻击不再伤害绑定女仆或触发她的受击反应。
- 玩家飞行时，绑定女仆在 8 格内跟随；宝珠保持她的当前区块加载，旧区块保留 30 秒。卸下、离线、退化或损毁时，撤销进化能力和宝珠提供的区块加载。
- 新增宝珠专属 HUD：悬停后长按任一 Alt 键约 0.5 秒打开，查看实时绑定、七项约定进度及进化能力；物品提示同步精简。
- 两颗宝珠采用粉色流动名称与独立像素纹理，HUD 使用玫粉边框、规整卡片和滚动布局。

适用 Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge。建议客户端和服务端同时更新至 1.7.3。必装潘多拉之咒 2.4.26+、Curios 5.4.5+；若安装 JEI，需 15.20.0.106 或更新版本；车万女仆为可选联动，需 1.5.3 或更新版本。

## English

- Fixed the Seventh Curse retaining its curse name after reversal, with fallback names for all seven blessings. Existing blessings display the correct name while other custom names are preserved.
- Reworked all seven JEI reversal guides to fit the native information-page width, with consistent numbering, wrapping and indentation. Long content is scrollable; chances and progress still update live.
- Added Love and its evolved form, Eternal Devotion · Never Forgotten, available only with Touhou Little Maid installed. Tame your very first maid while wearing a Pandora Necklace to receive Love once per player, permanently bound to that maid.
- Equip Love in a Pandora charm slot to share supported orb, curse, blessing and set-charm effects with your maids. Player-only mechanics and unadapted third-party effects are excluded.
- Evolution requires 24 hours worn and no death record for the bound maid. While equipped, have her deal 1,314,520 actual health damage, defeat her once each in Gomoku, Chinese chess and chess, spend over 30 minutes together in a Flower Forest in the same dimension, and send a chat vow containing both “女仆” and “我爱你” without forbidden words.
- After first wearing Love, taming another maid resets accumulated progress and reverts the evolved orb to Love; binding and death history remain. A message containing “女仆” and a forbidden word permanently destroys both forms, including creative copies and drops. Unequipping, relogging or evolving does not bypass penalties. Matching is literal: even a positive sentence containing “不” triggers destruction.
- Evolution retains charm sharing and grants you and your bound maid full-health recovery from lethal damage (separate 3-second cooldowns), flight, +1314% damage (×14.14) and exactly 520 effective armor. Your attacks no longer harm the bound maid or trigger her hit reactions.
- While you fly, the bound maid follows within 8 blocks. The orb keeps her current chunk loaded and retains previous chunks for 30 seconds. Unequipping, logging out, downgrading or destroying the orb removes its evolved powers and chunk loading.
- Added a dedicated orb HUD: hover either orb and hold either Alt key for about 0.5 seconds to view live binding, seven-promise progress and evolved powers. Item tooltips are now more compact.
- Both orbs have pink flowing names and their own pixel textures, alongside a rose-colored HUD with orderly cards and scrolling.

For Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge. Update both client and server to 1.7.3. Requires Curse of Pandora 2.4.26+ and Curios 5.4.5+. JEI is optional; if installed, use 15.20.0.106 or newer. Touhou Little Maid is optional; if installed, use 1.5.3 or newer.

releases.notes:
# Blessing of Pandora 1.5.1

Minecraft 1.20.1 · Forge · Client and server

Unified the Seventh Reality Curse enchantment counter across server conversion checks, HUD, and JEI. It now combines Forge-provided enchantments with stored enchantment data, counts each positive-level curse once, and supports standard curse flags from vanilla, Pandora's Curse, Celestial Enchantments, and other mods.  
统一服务端转化判定、HUD与JEI的现实第七诅咒附魔计数逻辑，合并Forge提供的附魔与物品存储的附魔数据；每种正等级诅咒只计数一次，兼容原版、潘多拉诅咒、星月附魔及其它使用标准诅咒标记的模组附魔。  
Fixed the Seventh Reality Curse live counter selecting an already converted blessing instead of the worn curse when both item forms are present.  
修复同时佩戴咒缚与解脱时，第七诅咒实时计数可能误选已转化祝福并显示为0的问题。  
Added Chinese and English acquisition descriptions to Pandora's Curse enchanted books, explaining cursed loot-chest equipment and the grindstone transfer method; retained its treasure-curse loot generation eligibility.  
为潘多拉诅咒附魔书新增中英文获取方式说明，介绍从战利品箱附魔装备获取并通过砂轮转移的方式，保留其宝藏诅咒附魔的战利品生成资格。  
Added grindstone transfer: place equipment carrying a stored Pandora's Curse and a regular book in either input order, then take one Pandora's Curse enchanted book. One regular book is consumed, all stored enchantments and the repair penalty are removed from the equipment, and the equipment stays in its original input slot with its damage, name, and other data preserved.  
新增砂轮转移：将实际存有潘多拉诅咒的装备与普通书分别放入两格，顺序不限；取出一本潘多拉诅咒附魔书时消耗一本普通书，清除装备全部存储附魔与修复惩罚，装备仍留在原输入格并保留耐久、名称及其它数据。  
Grindstone transfer does not change inputs before the result is taken, does not award additional experience, and does not extract permanent or dynamic-only enchantments into an unlimited supply of books.  
砂轮转移在取出结果前不会修改输入物品，不额外返还经验，也不从物品固有或仅动态提供的附魔中反复提取附魔书。  
Restricted direct reversal requests to creative players or operators holding the transformation debug stick, with server-side validation and matching HUD availability checks.  
限制直接转化操作为创造模式玩家或管理员手持转化调试棍时使用，加入服务端校验，并同步调整HUD按钮的可用性检查。  
Added independent ownership checks when reverting blessings, preventing another player's blessing from having its ownership erased through a revert-and-convert sequence.  
为祝福还原操作加入独立归属检查，防止通过先还原再转化清除其他玩家的祝福归属。  
Persisted the cursed-to-blessed count and restored it on login and player cloning after death. Players who already received the Epilogue recover a count of 7 if an older version lost it, without receiving another bracelet.  
持久化诅化祝计数，并在登录与死亡后的玩家重建时恢复；已领取终章但旧版本计数丢失的玩家会恢复到7，不会重复发放手环。  
Moved the Sixth Reality Curse's absorbed experience into player save data instead of a global static map, retaining progress across restarts and isolating different players and worlds; the existing reset-on-removal rule remains in place.  
将现实第六诅咒已吸收经验从全局静态表改存玩家存档，重启后保留进度，并隔离不同玩家与存档；保留取下对应物品时重置的既有规则。  
Calculated available experience from the player's level and experience bar instead of the historical totalExperience field, and credited the actual change after experience removal so level-granting commands and level costs no longer cause incorrect absorption accounting.  
按玩家等级与经验条计算当前可用经验，不再依赖历史totalExperience字段，并按扣除前后的实际经验变化记入进度，修复等级指令与等级消耗后吸收判定不准确的问题。  
Capped each Sixth Reality Curse absorption by available experience, the remaining requirement, and 50,000 points per tick, preventing the final absorption from consuming excess experience.  
将第六诅咒每次吸收量同时限制为当前可用经验、剩余需求与每刻50,000点的上限，避免最后一次吸收多扣经验。  
Synchronized server reversal settings on login, permission-page requests, and config reloads; made HUD and JEI descriptions read the received settings dynamically, and cleared client snapshots when disconnecting. Updated the network protocol so both sides must use the new version.  
在登录、请求反转权限面板与配置重载时同步服务器反转配置，使HUD与JEI说明动态读取同步值，并在断开连接时清理客户端缓存；更新网络协议，客户端与服务端均需更新。  
Stopped repeatedly overwriting valid custom settings, including a 4,000,000-point Sixth Curse requirement and minecraft:pig as the Fifth Curse target.  
停止重复覆盖合法自定义配置，包括4,000,000点的第六诅咒需求与minecraft:pig第五诅咒目标。

releases.notes:
# Blessing of Pandora 1.5.0

Minecraft 1.20.1 · Forge · Client and server

Made both reversal HUDs responsive and flow-based: the panel now follows the window size, text wraps within the available width, and content can scroll vertically on small windows without overflowing the HUD border.  
将所有反转HUD改为随窗口自适应的流式布局，面板会跟随窗口大小调整，文本按可用宽度换行，小窗口下可纵向滚动查看，不再超出HUD边框。  
Aligned each HUD row's description and button vertically on the same row, refined the button styling with gold trim and hover feedback, and added an ornamental double-gold HUD frame.  
对齐每个HUD行中的描述文本与按钮位置，优化按钮的金色描边、悬停反馈样式，并为HUD边框加入双层金色饰边。  
Reworked Soul Sculpting acquisition: the effect is now granted automatically while at least 3 other beneficial effects and 5 harmful effects are active, and is removed immediately when either count drops below the requirement.  
重做塑魂效果的获取方式：身上至少有3个其它正面效果和5个负面效果时自动获得，正面或负面效果数量不足时立即消失。  
Changed Soul Sculpting from level-based damage reduction to a persistent attribute-backed effect: affected entities gain 20% maximum health and take 20% bonus damage while the effect remains active.  
将塑魂从按等级减免伤害改为持续期间的属性效果：拥有塑魂的实体获得20%最大生命值提升，并受到20%额外伤害。  
Added a distinct Soul Sculpting acquisition line to its related item, HUD, and JEI descriptions, styled in aqua italics: obtain it while simultaneously having three beneficial effects and five harmful effects.  
在碎魂相关的物品、HUD与JEI描述中新增一段青蓝色斜体的塑魂获取方式说明：同时拥有三种正面效果和五种负面效果时获得塑魂。  
Added current curse/blessing wearing state descriptions to all seven reversal HUD and JEI pages, and restyled the not-wearing/current-state lines with distinct gray and green italics.  
为七个反转的HUD与JEI页面统一加入当前诅咒或祝福佩戴状态描述，并使用灰色、绿色斜体区分未佩戴与已佩戴状态。  
Made the Seventh Reality Curse description state explicitly that conversion is rolled every game tick, with the configured base chance and extra chance per curse enchantment shown as highlighted configurable values.  
将现实第七诅咒的转化描述补全为每个游戏刻都会进行一次概率判定，并明确显示基础概率和每个诅咒附魔额外增加的概率配置值。  
Added an option to disable detailed Blessing of Pandora logs, defaulting it to false so normal logs stay quiet; set enableDetailedLogs to true to restore the full diagnostic logs.  
新增关闭模组详细日志输出的配置项并默认关闭，平时不再输出日志；将enableDetailedLogs设为true后才会输出完整诊断日志。  
Updated the version to 1.5.0.  
版本号更新至1.5.0。

修改第六诅咒相关 HUD/JEI 描述，在未佩戴第六诅咒且未佩戴已完成安魂祝福时显示“当前没有佩戴第六诅咒”。
